sources.snippet: Typically, the selection of an ASR model for a specific application depends on a trade-off between model complexity and performance. When choosing a model, requirements guide this balance to ensure optimal performance while managing computational and resource constraints.

sources.title: Exploring the Integration of Large Language Models into Automatic ...
sources.snippet: This paper explores the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems to improve transcription accuracy. The increasing sophistication of LLMs, with their in-context learning capabilities and instruction-following behavior, has drawn significant attention in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP).
